status: DRAFT — authored by a first pass from the entity code, 2026-09-13; edit pending
artist_scope: full contract (Tier 2, the gait-scaled class (with hand-written FK chains on the tail and horns): geckolib_migration_design.md section 5); the rig is not yet in-game (it lands through the seam in a later slice)
character_sheet: A burning fox demon that walks upright: a chest and body, a head (built turned 180 degrees and turned back by the code) with two five-piece flame horns sweeping back from it, two-part arms and legs, and a nine-segment tail curling up and over its back - and every body part has a 'Fire' twin drawn over it, 21 pairs on a 512x256 sheet (KyuubiModel.java createBodyLayer). It is hostile: 125 HP, 10 attack, 10 armour (EntityKyuubi.java:65-72, MobStats.KYUUBI), fire-immune (ModEntities.java:254) and sets itself alight every few ticks (:82-89); water burns it (:90-91). Every tenth think tick it picks the nearest living thing that is not a monster within 12 blocks and in sight (:110-114, :131-154), walks at it and, within 8 blocks, hurls a small fireball from 1.25 blocks up on a roll (:115-125); it never bites. It floats (:57), panics when hurt (:58) and spawns anywhere (:180-184). Read it as a flaming, loping biped: arms and legs pumping with the stride, the tail and the two horns rippling in slow travelling waves, the head following the player.
size_notes: Drawn at x1.0 of the rig (KyuubiRenderer.java:24; no scale override) on a 512x256 sheet (KyuubiModel.java:317); the hitbox is 0.5 x 1.25 (ModEntities.java:252-254); shadow 0.1 (KyuubiRenderer.java:26).

groups.name: gait
groups.amplitude: legs: rests +0.59 / -0.15 rad (right thigh / shin), +0.26 / -0.44 (left), then pi x 0.2 = 0.628 rad (36 deg) x the walking speed above the 0.1 threshold; arms: rests 0 (upper) / +0.48 (lower), then pi x 0.08 = 0.251 rad (14 deg) x the walking speed, no threshold - each lower part slid 8 units along the upper part's pitch
groups.plain: the legs and arms pump with the stride at one rhythm - the right leg and right arm one way, the left leg and left arm the other - the legs three times as wide as the arms; each fire twin moves exactly with its part
groups.math: a = limbSwingAmount > 0.1 ? cos(t * 1.1 * 0.5) * pi * 0.2 * limbSwingAmount : 0; rtLegUpper(+Fire).xRot = 0.59 + a; rtLegLower(+Fire).xRot = -0.15 + a; lfLegUpper(+Fire).xRot = 0.26 - a; lfLegLower(+Fire).xRot = -0.44 - a; b = cos(t * 1.1 * 0.5) * pi * 0.08 * limbSwingAmount (+ the arm_breath term); rtArmUpper(+Fire).xRot = b; rtArmLower(+Fire).xRot = 0.48 + b; lfArmUpper(+Fire).xRot = -b; lfArmLower(+Fire).xRot = 0.48 - b; every lower part's z = sin(upper xRot) * 8
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 1.1 x 0.5 (wingspeed, KyuubiModel.java:13-14): the natural period is 2 pi / 0.55 = 11.4 ticks

groups.name: arm_breath
groups.amplitude: pi x 0.01 = 0.031 rad (2 deg), added to the arms' gait term at all times
groups.plain: a barely visible slow breathing of the arms, present even when standing
groups.math: rtArm*.xRot += cos(t * 0.5 * 0.5) * pi * 0.01; lfArm*.xRot -= the same
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 0.5 x 0.5: the natural period is 2 pi / 0.25 = 25.1 ticks

groups.name: horns
groups.amplitude: +0.244 rad rest splay (left) / -0.244 (right, mirrored), then pi x 0.1 = 0.314 rad (18 deg), each piece lagging the one before it by pi/4 - all on top of the head's look yaw
groups.plain: a travelling wave runs from the base to the tip of each flame horn, the two sides mirrored, the whole horn turning with the head
groups.math: lfHornK.yRot = headFire.yRot + 0.244 + cos(t * 1.3 * 0.5 - (K-1) * pi/4) * pi * 0.1; rtHornK.yRot = headFire.yRot - 0.244 - cos(t * 1.3 * 0.5 - (K-1) * pi/4) * pi * 0.1; each piece's x/z placed along the previous piece's yaw (3.6, 2, 4, 3, 2 units)
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 1.3 x 0.5: the natural period is 2 pi / 0.65 = 9.7 ticks

groups.name: tail_sway
groups.amplitude: pi x 0.2 = 0.628 rad (36 deg) per segment, each lagging the one before it by pi/4 (a full wave every eight segments)
groups.plain: a sideways wave travels up the nine-segment tail from the base to the tip
groups.math: tailK.yRot = cos(t * 0.9 * 0.5 - (K-1) * pi/4) * pi * 0.2; tail(K+1).x = tailK.x - sin(tailK.yRot) * L_K (L = 3, 4, 3.5, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1)
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 0.9 x 0.5: the natural period is 2 pi / 0.45 = 14 ticks

groups.name: tail_curl
groups.amplitude: rests -0.26 / -0.78 / -1.11 / -0.18 / +0.22 / +0.63 / +0.89 / +1.52 / +2.0 rad (the curl up and over the back), then pi x 0.1 = 0.314 rad (18 deg), each segment lagging the one before it by pi/4
groups.plain: a slower up-and-down ripple runs along the curled tail, the segments' y/z placed along the previous segment's pitch
groups.math: tailK.xRot = rest_K + cos(t * 0.5 * 0.5 - (K-1) * pi/4) * pi * 0.1; tail(K+1).y = tailK.y + sin(tailK.xRot) * L_K; tail(K+1).z = tailK.z - cos(tailK.xRot) * L_K
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 0.5 x 0.5: the natural period is 2 pi / 0.25 = 25.1 ticks

behaviour: One gait rhythm on the limbs (KyuubiModel.java:323-348): above a walking speed of 0.1 the cosine of the age x 1.1 x 0.5 (wingspeed), x pi x 0.2, x the walking speed pitches the right thigh and shin forward and the left pair back (rests +0.59 / -0.15 and +0.26 / -0.44 rad); the arms take the same cosine at pi x 0.08 x the walking speed (no threshold) plus a 2-degree breathing at 0.5 x 0.5 (:337), the right arm with the right leg. Each shin and forearm is slid 8 units along its upper part's pitch (:328-329, :334-335, :341-342, :347-348) - a hand-written FK chain on flat bones.

Every body part has a Fire twin (bodyFire, chestFire, headFire, the arm, leg and horn twins) posed to exactly the same angle as its part (:325, :327, :332, :334, :338, :340, :344, :346); the chest, body and tail root never move.

The head turns to the look (:350-351): the head part is built facing backward (its geo rotation is 180 deg about y) and the code adds pi to netHeadYaw, so `head` faces forward; `headFire` takes the look yaw straight. The horns hang from headFire's yaw: five pieces per side, each placed along the previous piece's yaw (3.6, 2, 4, 3, 2 units) and turned by +-0.244 rad plus a cosine at 1.3 x 0.5 lagging pi/4 per piece (:352-368) - an 18-degree wave running base to tip every 9.7 ticks, mirrored left and right.

The nine-segment tail carries two travelling waves (:369-410): a sideways one - 36 degrees per segment at 0.9 x 0.5, lagging pi/4 per segment, each segment's x placed along the previous yaw - and a slower up-and-down one at 0.5 x 0.5, 18 degrees around a curl that rises from -0.26 rad at the base to 2.0 rad at the tip, y and z placed along the previous pitch. The tail's bones are flat (no parents) in the rig, so when this rig lands a keyframed wave must key positions as well as rotations, or the tail must be re-parented.

Nothing in the pose reads the attack: the fireball leaves from 1.25 blocks up (EntityKyuubi.java:120-122) with no wind-up; the entity sets itself on fire every ~10 ticks (:82-89) and puffs smoke when water hurts it (:90-98).

wishlist: key every Fire twin exactly with its part (bodyFire with body, lfLegUppperFire with lfLegUpper, and so on): the code poses them identically (KyuubiModel.java:325-348) and a twin drifting off its part reads as a rendering bug

the tail and horn waves: the rig's bones are flat and the code slides each next segment along the previous one's angle (KyuubiModel.java:352-410) - author the waves as rotations and flag to the owner that the seam must either parent the chains or key the positions when the rig lands
in `attack`: a wind-up the code never had - the fireball simply appears at 1.25 blocks (EntityKyuubi.java:120-122); an arm flung forward and the horns flaring sell the throw
in `walk`: a lope, not a march - a heavier stride that dips the chest (the chest and body never move today) so the fire twins flicker with the step
in `idle`: a slow head-and-horn turn reading as the scan for prey (the code re-picks a target every tenth think tick, EntityKyuubi.java:110-114)
